{"decision":"✅ **DECIDED 2026-08-14 ON ANTHONY'S WORD, WITH A SCOPE CONDITION: BUILD EXACTLY ONE SLICE FIRST — CENTRALITY OVER THE `reasoning` PROJECTION — AND DO NOT SHIP THE GENERAL SURFACE UNTIL THAT ONE HAS PROVED USEFUL.**

The shape below is accepted. The sequencing is the ruling: the highest-value slice was already named inside this node, and `dec:orientation-is-computed-not-written` already records the missing capability in its own words — *"WHICH FEW DECISIONS SHAPE EVERYTHING ELSE... neither what-next nor where-am-i answers it today, and it is what a newcomer actually needs"* — and says it should be a COMPUTATION rather than another paragraph. **That computation is one call away and has never been made.**

⚠️ **THE TWO TRAPS TRAVEL WITH THE FIRST SLICE, NOT WITH THE GENERAL SURFACE**, so neither is deferred by narrowing scope: the exclusion list is part of the projection (the first hand run returned the ten most influential "decisions" as all `decision:ack:` review records; excluding them took the edge set 867 → 255), and the result is a READING, never a defect. Emitting defects from a broad projection is BL-42's exact shape, where one detector became 20 of 31 defects and had to be cut back.

⚠️ STILL NOT SETTLED BY THIS, and deliberately left to the first slice to answer in practice: whether this is a new served tool, an extension of `graph_report`, or an argument on existing detectors; whether a projection is a node type or a static list in code; and whether centrality should be betweenness (already imported) or reachability (what was computed by hand) — `dec:idea-is-betweenness-the-right-centrality` asks that and this does not answer it.

═══════════════ THE ACCEPTED SHAPE, AS PROPOSED ═══════════════

Anthony's framing 2026-08-10, and it is correct: graph algorithms run on any set of nodes and edges, so the analyses should be available across the design rather than wired one-per-detector. Measured basis in `fact:graph-analysis-covers-a-third-of-the-edge-types` — 23 of 35 populated edge types and 31% of edges get no graph analysis at all, including the entire golden thread and the delivery plan.

THE SHAPE: a PROJECTION is a named edge set plus its exclusions. Given one, run the standard battery — strongly-connected components and cycles, connected components, centrality, communities and modularity, articulation points, toposort depth — and REPORT IT AS MEASUREMENT, NEVER AS A VERDICT. `flow.rs` already uses exactly that language for its own cycles ("reported, never judged") and `dec:views-are-projections` already says every view is a projection, so this adds a surface rather than a concept.

FIVE STANDARD PROJECTIONS, each already exercised by hand on 2026-08-10: golden thread (SATISFIES+REALIZES+VERIFIES+ALLOCATED_TO), reasoning (GOVERNED_BY+OBSOLETES+CAUSES+ANTICIPATES), the plan (PRECEDES+SCHEDULED_FOR), structure (the existing DEPENDS_ON + contract-derived set, unchanged), and risk (RISKS+BLOCKS+CONTRADICTS+VIOLATES+MASKS).

THE EXCLUSION LIST IS PART OF THE PROJECTION, NOT A CAVEAT. `structure.rs` already excludes review records and `heal.rs` already names ARTIFACT_BOOKKEEPING (INCLUDES, CHANGED, YIELDED, AT_EPOCH). Those exclusions exist as private constants inside detectors; a projection surface has to lift them into the projection definition or every general run gives a confident wrong answer.

MEASUREMENT AND JUDGEMENT STAY SEPARATE. A battery result is a reading. A finding becomes a DEFECT only where somebody has decided what that finding MEANS for that projection — a cycle in DEPENDS_ON is a defect, a cycle in CAUSES+OBSOLETES turned out to be an ordinary time sequence.

WHAT IS EXPLICITLY NOT PROPOSED: running every algorithm over every edge type and raising what it finds.
